name: Installed npm package rehearsal
description: The packed artifact installs into a clean prefix and supports repository setup before requirements, installed skills, a reviewed example change, and a rendered desktop.

passage.quote: The launcher resolves the built desktop and Electron runtime from its own installation, independently of the caller’s working directory. The package includes JavaScript, styling, fonts, the logo, and skills; installation obtains Electron through its runtime dependency. A missing build or unavailable Electron runtime produces an actionable error instead of trying to compile or download during launch.
